notes.title: Shelve your Bloodborne remaster conspiracies for five minutes, its legally distinct kart racing sibling is getting a beefy looking expansion
notes.content:
You. Yes, you. Stop developing weird theories in response to recent DMCA takedowns that'll probably leave you disappointed. Forget that Bloodborne remaster/PC port you're desperate for. Why? Well, its weird, unofficial kart racing spin-off just had some fresh DLC announced for it.

notes.title: Nightmare Kart Expansion DLC Announced: The Old Karts!
notes.content:
Announcing Nightmare Kart: The Old Karts!

This free expansion DLC will add new content to the game, including:

💉 New mini campaign!
🏎️ New racers & karts!
🗺️ New tracks!
💥 New power ups & game modes!

Coming soon!

notes.title: Version 1.12.2 Hotfix!
notes.content: The 1.12.2 hotfix is now live, which fixes a bug that prevents the "Legally succinct!" achievement from unlocking.

notes.title: Version 1.12 Achievement Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vmPztR95/version-1-12-title.png[/img]

Update 1.12, the Achievement update, is out now! Check out the new features below:

-Unlockable achievements for both Steam and non-Steam versions
-Statistics page for tracking gameplay data and other interesting stats
-Track records will now be recognized and saved to file

notes.title: Version 1.11 First Person Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/cCR9bxHK/version-1-11-Title.png[/img]

Update 1.11 is out now! On top of adding a first person mode that can be toggled via R3, A bunch of bugs fixes and other changes have been made. Check out the list below:

-App window settings will now properly save and apply on startup
-Stick turning sensitivity (Helps compatibility with steering wheels and adaptive controllers)
-Removed infinite insight bug
-Camera distance can now be changed via a new rebindable button (R3 by default)
-Speedometer will no longer disappear after respawning
-Timers are longer inaccurate at an FPS higher than 144
-Addressed jump pad inaccuracies during the last 2 boss fights.
-The two trench exit ramps are no longer too steep in Pocket Dream Field

notes.title: Version 1.10 Update!
notes.content:
Update 1.10 is out now! Check out the change list below:

-Various main menu UI navigation bug fixes for main menu
-'Random' selection in free play no longer only selects dream watchers
-Wrong custom voice loading in some campaign saves
-Pressing start on pause screen will no longer unpause for only one frame
-Custom graphics settings now properly load in campaign interstitial menu

notes.title: Version 1.09 Update!
notes.content:
Version 1.09 is now live, check out the fix list below:

-AI no longer has worse handling at higher FPS
-Damage slowdown reduced significantly
-Timer is now accurate at higher FPS
-Human players are now marked with arrows during split screen races
-Removed incompatible battle mode type configurations
-Further AI navigation improvements

notes.title: Version 1.08 Update!
notes.content:
Version 1.08 is now live! Check out the list below:

-Analog steering (old digital steering can be enabled in accessibility menu)
-Improved drift handling
-Button rebinding and accessibility are now available across both main menu and gameplay option screens
-Pressing the back button on the button rebinding menu will now save the current rebindings (before it would only save when pressing the confirm button)

notes.title: Version 1.07 Update!
notes.content:
Nightmare Kart version 1.07 is live! Check out the list below:

-In game input icons (Tutorial, Visceral boost ect) will now properly show rebound buttons
-Keyboard support for tutorial
-Removed aether vials from roulette across all campaign battle mode levels
-Fixed 'acceleration stop' bug present when using a certain power up during a certain boss fight
-Fixed minor track checkpoint placement in outsiders mansion track
-Added more track chevrons in outsiders manson track
-Doubled melee weapon power up hitbox range

notes.title: Version 1.06 Update!
notes.content:
It's time for the version 1.06 update! Check out the full list below:

-Fixed default button in button rebinding menu
-Added default button in graphics settings menu

Not a lot for this update, but don't worry, there will be more updates in the near future!

notes.title: Version 1.05 Update!
notes.content:
Hey all! Update 1.05 is live, which addresses issues such as:

-Fixed missing fodder unlock for free play
-Enemy mobs respawn during races
-Racers at the back get more blood droplets per mob kill than racers at the front
-Removed evil clone from sewer circuit
-Fixed Nicholas not attacking during his boss fight battle phases
-Added jump pads to battle mode minimaps
-More AI navigation fixes and tweaks

notes.title: Version 1.04 Update!
notes.content:
​Update for version 1.04 is now live!

(Due to the steam version being delayed, the game actually launched at version 1.03!)

Bugs that were fixed include:

-Subtitles now properly load in Matilda Sisters cutscene
-Camera bug fix pertaining to visceral boosting Gregory into the third phase
-Fixed a variable caching issue causing free play data to load into campaign mode
-Further AI navigation fixes

notes.title: Nightmare Kart, the Bloodborne-inspired PSX-styled racing game, is out now
notes.content:
I haven't played Bloodborne and so references to its world or characters mean little to me. Kart racers, meanwhile? There I'm in my element due to a lifetime of Mario Kart, Diddy Kong Racing and Sonic & All-Stars Racing Transformed. It's those games that make me interested in Nightmare Kart, a PSX-aesthetic racing game which was formerly known as Bloodborne Kart, and which is out now.

notes.title: Who needs Bloodborne anyway? Nightmare Kart is out right now
notes.content:
Did you finish watching the Sony State of Play and were left unsatiated? Still holding on to hope that Bloodborne 2 or a Bloodborne remaster might happen? Well through those dreams aside - you don't need 'em! That's because Nightmare Kart (formerly known as Bloodborne Kart) is out right now.

The PSX gothic Kart racer is available for free right now on Itch.io,(and on Steam later when it passes review) and it provides a legally distinct race through a somewhat familiar gothic setting with a cast of vaguely recognizable characters. Those who wish to support the developer can donate to them directly, while the rest of the world zooms off at zero cost.

Nightmare Kart was meant to come out some time ago, but the development team was struck by a DMCA notice by Sony Interactive Entertainment. This resulted in a month's long process of removing all Bloodborne content from the game, replacing it with original gothic content that shares the same feel as the beloved From Software game, but without any of that pesky IP attached.
